name: Richard Regeler
original_name: リヒャルト＝リーゲラー
source:
A former army soldier with the rank of second lieutenant.

Although he has an extremely violent and impulsive personality, he also has the strength of will to endure and follow through if the major tells him not to lay hands on someone.
That's why the major trusts him and keeps him by his side.

He shines the most when he destroys a woman with the major's permission.


[Translated from [url=https://www.turumiku.jp/product/gouhou/#character_sub]the official site[/url]]
